title: Log regularity of an invertible-order normalization over a regular boundary
statement:
Let $Y$ be an integral excellent regular Noetherian scheme and $T\subset Y$ a strict normal crossings boundary, allowing the empty boundary. Let $G$ be a finite group whose order is invertible on $Y$, and let $V'\to V=Y\setminus|T|$ be a connected finite etale $G$-torsor (the action is simply transitive on each geometric fibre). Let $b:Y'\to Y$ be the normalization of $Y$ in the function field of $V'$. Then $b$ is finite, $Y'$ is integral excellent Noetherian, and $(Y',b^{-1}|T|)$ is a log regular pair.

The notions are [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-exc-excellent-ring], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], [def-sc-normalization], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-trf-log-regular-pair]. Normalization in the indicated finite extension $L$ of the function field means the scheme obtained by gluing $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the integral closure of each affine coordinate domain in $L$; thus the extension field, rather than just the original function field, is used.

source.place: Expose IX Proposition 2.1(i)--(iii) and paragraph 2.2, printed pp. 133--134; log regularity under the resulting Kummer etale cover is Expose VI 1.8 and 2.3, printed pp. 70 and 73.
